story.title: Amitabh Bachchan reveals how he manages household chores
story.summary: Amitabh Bachchan revealed his approach to household chores when domestic help is absent, handling cleaning himself while relying on Jaya Bachchan for cooking. He mentioned his preference for ordering food, noting that Jaya enjoys preparing dishes upon his request. Additionally, he shared how he keeps his family informed about late returns from film shoots through group messages.

story.title: How Tamil actor M.R. Radha got away with staging a ‘banned’ play in 1959
story.summary: The Madras Government, in April 1959, banned popular actor M.R. Radha’s Tamil play Thooku Medai. He submitted the script of another drama Kathal Bali to the Madras Commissioner of Police and obtained a licence to perform it. On noticing that the play was similar to the banned Thooku Medai, the police registered a case.
